description: This file defines the `absl::Cleanup` class, which implements scope guard idiom for executing callbacks upon scope exit. It includes methods for canceling or invoking the callback early, and provides type deduction utilities for creating cleanup objects.

classes.name: absl::Cleanup
classes.description: A scope guard class that executes a callback upon destruction unless canceled or invoked early.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Constructor that takes a callback to be executed on scope exit.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Executes the callback early and prevents it from executing again on destruction.
